description: Two short curved wings round a glazed drum, low enough that the towers behind it clear it on both sides. It was marketed as workspace, sold as workspace and is used as storage: through the drum glazing you can see racking, pallets and about four hundred identical chrome-fronted kitchen units still in their wrapping. The doors on the Sorrel Way side are propped with a fire extinguisher during the day and there is a counter three paces inside them, which is not what the drum was drawn for and is what it is.
